title: Made in Slovenia — marquees as section dividers
note: Swiss editorial grid on white: full-bleed colour blocks (lilac, yellow, pink, green, black), 1px rules, one grotesk (Favorit) at extreme size contrast. Giant looping "MADE IN SLOVENIA ✺ GIFTS" marquee bands split sections; tilted black-and-white ticker ribbons cross a green call-out; nav links grow big after the hero. Webflow.
